recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It applies the accepted wording to the active Composition definition while avoiding inactive/generated artifacts; no follow-up is indicated unless the Structured Documents work group wants a broader modern terminology review of Composition.section.
issue_request: FHIR-7430 was a Published/Persuasive Structured Documents change request for FHIR-core Composition asking to change the Composition section definition from "The root of the sections that make up the composition." to "The root of the contents that make up the composition." The Jira resolution was to make the change as recommended.
initial_application: The Jira comments record acceptance and svn revision #6190, but current git/source evidence still had the original "sections" wording. Pickaxe searches found no prior occurrence of the accepted "contents" wording in the active Composition StructureDefinition, and the old phrase was carried into the current XML source by the 2021 source rework.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists composition=Composition, making source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml current build input. The old wording also appears in a commented-out CDA profile and a generated-looking SVG, but those were not authoritative current-build fixes. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later decision reversing the old ballot resolution.
reconciliation: Changed only source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml so Composition.section now says "The root of the contents that make up the composition."
source_changes: source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml: changed the Composition.section definition from "sections" to "contents".
